metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for tropospheric NO2 measurements (https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/COPERNICUS_S5P_NRTI_L3_NO2) - Date ranges: January 1-20, 2020 and February 10-25, 2020 - Location: Hong Kong (approximately 22.3°N, 114.1°E) - This is real-time NRTI data, should be available for these dates 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P NO2 data includes QA filtering. Use the QA_VALUE band to filter (typically QA_VALUE >= 0.75) - No cloud masking needed as TROPOMI measures through clouds - Filter out pixels with low data quality 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection size for both date ranges (if 0, output C1) - Check valid pixel counts after QA filtering (if 0, output C2) - Ensure mean NO2 values are within realistic range (5-500 ppb) - Compare means: if Feb mean < Jan mean → A (Yes, decreased), else → B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Hong Kong geometry hk_coords = [114.1, 22.3] hk_point = ee.Geometry.Point(hk_coords) hk_buffer = hk_point.buffer(50000) # 50km buffer # 2. January 1-20, 2020 jan_start = '2020-01-01' jan_end = '2020-01-20' jan_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') \ .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) \ .filterBounds(hk_buffer) jan_size = jan_col.size().getInfo() print(f"January collection size: {jan_size}") if jan_size == 0: print("No data for January.") print("C1") else: # Calculate mean NO2 for January with QA filtering jan_mean_img = jan_col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_VALUE').gte(0.75))) \ .mean() jan_mean = jan_mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=hk_buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() jan_count = jan_mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=hk_buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Jan mean NO2: {jan_mean:.2e} (pixels: {int(jan_count) if jan_count else 0})") # 3. February 10-25, 2020 feb_start = '2020-02-10' feb_end = '2020-02-25' feb_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') \ .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) \ .filterBounds(hk_buffer) feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo() print(f"February collection size: {feb_size}") if feb_size == 0: print("No data for February.") print("C1") else: # Calculate mean NO2 for February with QA filtering feb_mean_img = feb_col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_VALUE').gte(0.75))) \ .mean() feb_mean = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=hk_buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() feb_count = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=hk_buffer, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() print(f"Feb mean NO2: {feb_mean:.2e} (pixels: {int(feb_count) if feb_count else 0})") # 4. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Hong Kong geometry
hk_coords = [114.1, 22.3]
hk_point = ee.Geometry.Point(hk_coords)
hk_buffer = hk_point.buffer(50000)  # 50km buffer

# 2. January 1-20, 2020
jan_start = '2020-01-01'
jan_end = '2020-01-20'
jan_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') \
    .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) \
    .filterBounds(hk_buffer)

jan_size = jan_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"January collection size: {jan_size}")

if jan_size == 0:
    print("No data for January.")
    print("C1")
else:
    # Calculate mean NO2 for January with QA filtering
    jan_mean_img = jan_col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_VALUE').gte(0.75))) \
        .mean()
    jan_mean = jan_mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=hk_buffer,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    jan_count = jan_mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=hk_buffer,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Jan mean NO2: {jan_mean:.2e} (pixels: {int(jan_count) if jan_count else 0})")
    
    # 3. February 10-25, 2020
    feb_start = '2020-02-10'
    feb_end = '2020-02-25'
    feb_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2') \
        .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) \
        .filterBounds(hk_buffer)
    
    feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"February collection size: {feb_size}")
    
    if feb_size == 0:
        print("No data for February.")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # Calculate mean NO2 for February with QA filtering
        feb_mean_img = feb_col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_VALUE').gte(0.75))) \
            .mean()
        feb_mean = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=hk_buffer,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        feb_count = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=hk_buffer,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Feb mean NO2: {feb_mean:.2e} (pixels: {int(feb_count) if feb_count else 0})")
        
        # 4. Validation
        if jan_count == 0 or feb_count == 0:
            print("C2")
        elif jan_mean is None or feb_mean is None:
            print("C3")
        else:
            # 5. Compare
            print(f"Jan: {jan_mean:.2e}, Feb: {feb_mean:.2e}, Diff: {(feb_mean-jan_mean):.2e}")
            if feb_mean < jan_mean:
                print("A")
            else:
                print("B")
